name: Relief
author: E. T. Carter
description: A slowly morphing topographic relief — elevation shaded by hillshade so the terrain reads as carved, threaded with crisp contour lines and heavier index lines. A premium embossed map, geometry from a height field.

params.label: Terrain scale
params.effect: Feature scale of the terrain; low is broad landforms, high is fine ridged detail.

params.label: Contours
params.effect: How many contour lines band the elevation; low is bold, high a fine survey.

params.label: Emboss
params.effect: Strength of the carved hillshade relief; 0 is flat tinted bands, high is deeply embossed.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How fast the terrain morphs; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pushes the terrain up beneath it; 0 ignores the mouse.
